messages:
maya: Quick async standup — roadmap/specs/launch prep for routing fallback

maya: Did: finalized v1 spec for routing fallback and added unit + integration tests. Opened infra PR with rollback hook.
maya: Blockers: waiting on UX copy for the error state (retry CTA) and need @sam to review the security-related log changes.
maya: Today: merge PR if reviews are green, prepare canary playbook, sync with infra about burst capacity for the rollout.

sam: Thanks — can you drop the PR link? I want to run a quick audit on the new log lines.

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/421 — primary change is the rollback hook and added structured logs. Note: some fields are redacted but we still log request_id + route_key.

maya: @sam can you check the redaction logic (lines ~120-145)?

vikram: Quick perf note: validated staging throughput for the routing changes. p50/p95 fine, p99 within target on our dedicated nodes. Seeing an autoscale lag of ~30-45s when burst starts — likely K8s scale-up + cold GPU spin.

olivia: For launch prep I can own the rollout doc and the runbook. Will draft 5% -> 25% -> 100% plan with rollback criteria and alert thresholds.

maya: That'd be great. My suggested rollout windows: 5% (30m observe) -> 25% (1h observe) -> 100% (if stable). Include prefix cache hit rate, 99th latency, and error budget burn as gates.

olivia: noted. Will include a checklist + slack pager routing for alerts.

sam: Reviewing the PR now. One callout: the extra log line includes user_agent, we should avoid logging raw UA for PII concerns. Prefer anonymized UA bucket or hash.

vikram: +1 on anonymizing UA. Also add a KV-cache health metric so we can detect cache tombstone spikes during warmup. That was a minor hiccup last rollout.

ops-bot: capacity-check: dedicated-pool-west has 12 free GPUs and can sustain a 100rps canary for up to 3 hours. No immediate capacity conflicts flagged. :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks @ops-bot. Revised blockers: need UX copy + sam to finish review + confirm anonymized UA approach.

tia: UX input: I prefer CTA text "Try again" for transient errors — shorter and less technical. Uploaded updated mock (Figma): https://figma.com/file/xyz. If legal asks, we can swap to "Retry later."

sam: I can implement anonymized UA buckets in the log shim and update the PR today. Aiming to merge by 17:00 PST if no other blockers.

vikram: Also recommend adding a healthcheck that emits a short spike metric on cache miss rate so the runbook can auto-detect regressions.

olivia: I'll add that metric to the rollout doc and the alert set.

maya: Awesome — thanks team. If PR is merged and UX copy is approved, we can cut canary tomorrow morning PST.

sam: On it. Will ping here once merged.

maya: closing notes: anyone who wants to review the test scenarios, they're in the PR description (edge cases + chaos scenarios). ping me if you want a quick walkthrough. :thumbsup:
